description:
View account info, pricing, entitlements, or list keys.
Actions:
  "status"  (default) → tier, quota, usage from /me/entitlements
  "pricing"           → public pricing tiers (no auth required)
  "keys"              → list user's API keys with per-key usage
  "usage"             → alias for "keys" (per-key usage is shown there)
  "history"           → whether request history (parsed output kept for
                        replay) is on for this account
  "history_on" / "history_off" → change it for the account and all its keys
Deleting history is deliberately not an MCP action: it stays on
POST /api/v1/requests/delete and the dashboard.
name: mcpAccount
